screenshots.GoT_60s: Menu text and mist/particles visible, sword and foreground still black; 13 FPS overlay.
screenshots.GoT_80_95_110s: Same failed menu rendering persists; 110s overlay 9 FPS. Diagnostic timestamps perturb performance, so no benchmark claim.
screenshots.GoW_8_25s: Startup captures only; guard stops at 32.865 seconds. This run does not reproduce the previous cutscene stall.

attribution.GoW: At 31.473 seconds free VRAM falls to 221,048,832 bytes. A new llama-server process PID82790 holds about 15.1 GiB in both DRM and KFD evidence in the identified Docker container. The Ollama API still returns empty model lists; API unloading is insufficient to isolate the test. Kernel logs record 4,329 user-page failures. This is a memory-headroom failure, not a new graphics-ring timeout.
attribution.GoT: No API-reported model load, no GPU failure, and at least 16.37 GiB free throughout. The missing menu materials cannot be explained by the later GoW VRAM exhaustion. Prior offset emission is active for all three affected shaders; no dropped-offset warning remains. It has not restored the menu.
attribution.scaled_blend: No scaled MIN/MAX blend warning appears in this menu capture; do not treat the earlier gameplay attachment warning as the established menu cause.

native_build_validation: Uploaded build record passes native build, retained CPU regressions and executable startup checks for e23b58da. No emulator code changed in PR196, so this successful build is reused.

container_policy.discovery: Local Unix Docker endpoint only. Select exact Ollama name/Compose service/image repository plus explicitly supplied evidence container IDs. Reject a missing explicit ID, unstable state or Swarm-managed target. No broad container shutdown.
container_policy.before_stop: Persist exact IDs, image/creation identity, running state, restart policy and available model metadata. Snapshot current APIs where available; an identified non-API inference container can still be stopped and restarted.
container_policy.during_batch: Stop running targets once for both games; verify stopped state and log periodic inspections. Do not reload between games. Abort if identity/state changes or monitoring fails. Keep existing 8 GiB, 118+2-second and owned-process safeguards.
container_policy.restore: Restart only containers that this batch stopped, after owned emulator shutdown and no observed GPU failure. Leave originally stopped containers stopped and unrelated services untouched. Refresh container IPs; restore captured model context/digest/remaining lease using the existing guarded restore path. Preserve externally changed state.
container_policy.defer: GPU failure, live/unconfirmed child or incomplete evidence defers restart; durable lease and an explicit recovery command are printed. Recovery checks current ownership, kernel health, endpoint and identities. A pending lease blocks another batch.
container_policy.sudo: Existing single sudo -v after build/reuse; Docker fallback and kernel reads use sudo -n. No password stored or repeated interactive prompt.

shader_collection: Prioritize up to 64 descriptor-provenance shader hashes, ranking recorded GPU work first. GPU-progress and validation hashes remain ahead. All existing IR/binary limits and missing-evidence reporting remain. Preserve first-game-only capture option.
